svg.title: SimpleARM — Simple Agentic Robot Memory
svg.desc: Fully vector artwork. Robot scenes, icons and annotations contain only vector geometry and text; no raster image is embedded. Natural shading is approximated by colored spline contours. Canvas 3840 x 1600; resolution-independent geometry.
